title: Promega BacTiter-Glo Assay
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ekhtcw

steps.title: Prepare BacTiter-Glo reagent mix
steps.instruction: Create the reagent mix by transferring the BacTiter-Glo buffer into the BacTiter-Glo substrate.

steps.title: Aliquot cells into plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of cells into two wells of a 96-well plate to create duplicates.

steps.title: Add reagent mix
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the prepared BacTiter-Glo reagent mix into each well.

steps.title: Measure luminescence
steps.instruction: Measure the luminescence using a Cytation 5 microplate reader (BioTek).
